mBuff.mDescription:
Ally champions gain @MSPercentAlly*100@% Move Speed moving towards Janna.

Janna deals @BonusDamage@ bonus magic damage %i:OnHit% On-Hit and with Zephyr.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Janna and her allied champions gain 3% increased Movement Speed.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Janna and her allied champions gain 3% increased <speed>Movement Speed</speed>.
Absorbs the next @f1@ damage taken and grants the unit bonus Attack Damage.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Janna conjures a defensive gale that shields an ally champion or turret from incoming damage and increases their Attack Damage.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Shields an allied Champion or turret for @ShieldDuration@ seconds. The shield absorbs up to <shield>@TotalShield@ damage</shield> and grants <physicalDamage>@BonusAD@ Attack Damage</physicalDamage> until it breaks.
Janna can activate Howling Gale to release her whirlwind.

mLocKeys.keySummary: By creating a localized change in pressure and temperature, Janna is able to create a small storm that grows in size with time. She can active the spell again to release the storm. On release this storm will fly towards the direction it was cast in, dealing damage and knocking away any enemies in its path.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Summons a whirlwind, which deals @MinimumDamage@ magic damage to all enemies in its path and Knocks them into the air. The whirlwind travels further, deals @ChargeDamage@ bonus damage, and Knocks enemies higher, for each second it charges (up to a maximum of 3 seconds).

Recast to release the whirlwind early.
Janna has conjured a magical storm, healing nearby allies every second.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Janna surrounds herself in a magical storm, throwing enemies back. After the storm has settled, soothing winds heal nearby allies while the ability is active.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Summons forth the might of the wind to <recast>Knockback</recast> surrounding enemies and restores <healing>@TotalHeal@ Health</healing> to nearby allies over 4 seconds.
Janna's movement speed is increased, and she is able to move through units.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Janna summons an air elemental that passively increases her Movement Speed and enables her to pass through units. She may also activate this ability to deal damage and slow an enemy's Movement Speed. The passive is lost while this ability is on cooldown.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Passive: Increases Movement Speed by @MSPercent*100@% and allows movement through units.

Active: Deals @TotalDamage@ magic damage to an enemy and Slows by @MovementSpeedForTooltip@% for @SlowDuration@ seconds. Passive benefit is lost while Zephyr is on cooldown.
